# Tabs

> A row of tabs on a 1px line. One is selected, and its panel shows below.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabs` | slot |  |  |

## Anatomy

- `root`: The `role="tablist"`. The tabs sit side by side, with nothing between them.

## When to use

- Above the panels it switches between.

## When not to use

- More tabs than fit on one line. Fewer, or a menu.

## Behaviour

One tab is selected at a time. Changing it swaps the panel below; nothing else on the page moves.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: `role="tablist"` holding the tabs. Each panel is a `role="tabpanel"` labelled by its tab.
- **Name**: an `aria-label` on the tablist that says what it switches, like "Example".
- **Keyboard**: Tab lands on the selected tab and the next Tab goes into its panel. Arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs (see **TabItem**).
- **Focus**: on the tabs themselves, each with its own `focus-ring`.

## Content

Tabs that belong together, in the order people need them.

## No token, on purpose

| Part | Property | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `root` | `box-shadow` | `inset 0 calc(-1 * var(--spacing-outline-small)) 0 0 var(--tabs-line)` | Figma's 1px line along the bottom, drawn inside so the row stays 40px tall and the selected tab's underline sits on top of it. The width and colour are tokens (spacing/outline/small, tabs/line). |

See it live, with every value of every variant: [rost.build/components/tabs](https://rost.build/components/tabs/)
